scope: Operator-imported documents indexed on the same host; no network retrieval.
license: Per-document; bundled first-party demonstration content is Apache-2.0.

rights.retrieval: Operator must have permission to ingest and index each document.
rights.retention: Conditional on each document's rights; retained until operator removal.
rights.display: Conditional on each document's rights; title and extracted snippet preserve its license and attribution.
rights.redistribution: Conditional on each document's rights; importing a document does not grant redistribution rights.
rights.evaluation: Only when each document's rights permit the proposed evaluation use.
rights.training: Not enabled by the MVP; future training requires per-document rights review and separate user-data opt-in.

attribution: Preserve supplied attribution and license per candidate, including after deduplication.
limitations: A supplied license string is an operator assertion, not automated legal verification.
The bundled demo corpus is synthetic first-party project material, not general-web coverage.
Local result URLs are displayed but never fetched by the MVP.
This manifest is a review record; it is not a blanket license for imported content.
